info.title: Protecto API
info.description:
Protecto is a data privacy and security platform providing PII/PHI/PCI detection, tokenization-based masking, unmasking, policy management, and data scanning. Use this API to protect sensitive data in AI/LLM pipelines, application logs, analytics, and more.

## Authentication

All endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN
```

Obtain your token from the [Protecto Portal](https://portal.protecto.ai/).

## Environments

| Environment | Base URL |
|-------------|----------|
| Trial       | `https://protecto-trial.protecto.ai` |
| Production  | `https://api.protecto.ai` |

put.description:
Masks one or more sensitive values. Supports four modes depending on the fields provided in each item:

- **Mask with Token** – provide `value` + `token_name`. Explicit token type, no structure preservation.
- **Mask with Format** – provide `value` + `format` + `token_name`. Structure-preserving masking.
- **Identify and Mask (Auto-Detect)** – provide `value` only. Automatically detects and masks all PII entities in free-form text using the active policy.
- **Mask with Policy** – provide `policy_name` at request level + `value` per item. Detection and tokenization driven by a named policy.
- **Mask with Attributes** – provide `value` + optional `format`, `token_name`, and `attributes` metadata.

Masking is **deterministic**: the same value with the same token type always produces the same token.

mask.value: Sarah Connors can be reached at 217-555-2020 or sarah.connors88@example.com
Call me at +1-800-555-0100 or email me at alice@example.com

data.value: Sarah Connors can be reached at 217-555-2020 or sarah.connors88@example.com

put.description:
Restores the original sensitive values from tokenized text. Resolves all embedded entity tokens automatically — no `token_name` is required. Optionally applies a named policy.

> **Security note:** Restrict unmasking to trusted services and users. Audit all unmask operations and enforce role-based access control.

unmask.token_value: <PER>VJYe 03W</PER>, an <NATIONALITY>Q534kH4v</NATIONALITY>, can be reached via email at <EMAIL>1AI0s@Uzm3a</EMAIL> or phone at <PHN>+8-065-029-0616</PHN>

data.value: John Doe, an American, can be reached via email at johndoe@example.com or phone at +1-123-456-7890
data.token_value: <PER>VJYe 03W</PER>, an <NATIONALITY>Q534kH4v</NATIONALITY>, can be reached via email at <EMAIL>1AI0s@Uzm3a</EMAIL> or phone at <PHN>+8-065-029-0616</PHN>

put.description:
Submits a masking job for asynchronous processing. Returns a `tracking_id` immediately. Poll `/api/vault/async-status` with the tracking ID to retrieve results.

Accepts the same request body as the synchronous mask endpoint. Recommended for large payloads that exceed synchronous limits.
Submits an unmasking job for asynchronous processing. Returns a `tracking_id` immediately. Poll `/api/vault/async-status` to retrieve results when complete.

Retrieves the current status of one or more async jobs by tracking ID. Poll this endpoint every 30–60 seconds until `status` is `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, or `PURGED`.

**Status lifecycle:** `PENDING` → `IN-PROGRESS` → `SUCCESS` | `FAILED` | `PURGED`

data.error_msg: Processing Async request failed: Payload is empty

put.description:
Submits an asynchronous job to scan a data source for PII/PHI/PCI entities. Returns a `tracking_id` to poll for results.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription.
Checks the status of a previously submitted data scan job using its tracking ID.

get.description: Returns a list of all objects (tables, files, etc.) that have been submitted for scanning.
Returns column-level PII detection results for a specific scanned object.

parameters.name: object_name
parameters.description: The name of the scanned object to retrieve details for

put.description: Adjusts confidence thresholds or accepts/rejects detected entity conclusions for a scanned object.
Corrects or removes ML-detected PII entities in a scanned object.

Runs custom PII detection against provided text using your registered custom tag endpoints.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription.

example.text: Customer ID: CUST-98765 placed an order today.

put.summary: Create or update a custom tag
put.description:
Creates or updates a custom PII entity tag with an identification endpoint configuration.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and `metadata_change` permission.

put.summary: Configure whitelist endpoint for a custom tag
put.description:
Sets or updates the whitelist endpoint used to exclude known-safe values from custom PII detection.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and `metadata_change` permission.

get.description: Fetches the configuration of a custom PII tag including its identification endpoint.

parameters.name: tag_type
parameters.description: The custom tag type name to retrieve

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a custom PII entity tag and its configuration.

> **Requires:** `metadata_change` permission.

parameters.name: tag_type
parameters.description: The custom tag type name to delete

put.description:
Creates a named policy that controls which entity types are detected and how they are tokenized. All entities default to pseudonymizable upon creation.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and `metadata_change` permission.

data.description: Policy for masking PII in customer support tickets

get.description: Returns a list of all policies defined in the namespace.
Fetches the full configuration of a named policy.

put.description: Configures which entity categories are enabled or disabled in a policy, and whether they are anonymized or pseudonymized.

put.summary: Update policy prefix and suffix tags
put.description: Customizes the entity tag wrappers (e.g., `<PERSON>`, `</PERSON>`) used in tokenized output for a policy.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a named policy.

> **Requires:** `metadata_change` permission.

parameters.name: policy_name
parameters.description: The name of the policy to delete

put.description:
Creates an authentication token for a user within a specific namespace. If the namespace does not already exist, it is created asynchronously.

> **Requires:** Master API Key in the `Authorization` header.

get.description:
Fetches details of a specific auth token in a namespace.

> **Requires:** Master API Key.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: User ID or email associated with the token

get.description:
Returns all auth tokens defined within a namespace.

> **Requires:** Master API Key.

put.description:
Revokes an auth token, immediately preventing further API access for the associated user.

> **Requires:** Master API Key.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes an entire namespace and all its associated data.

> **Requires:** Master API Key. This action is irreversible.

get.description:
Returns the current status of namespace-level background jobs (e.g., namespace creation).

> **Requires:** Master API Key.

Returns API usage statistics broken down by user within the namespace.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and Admin token.

Returns aggregated API usage statistics for the current namespace.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and Admin token.

Returns aggregated API usage statistics across all namespaces. Only available to super admin tokens.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and Master API Key.

Returns detailed audit logs for API calls made within the namespace, including caller identity, operation type, and timestamps.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and Admin token.

put.description:
Submits a job to delete the token-to-value mappings for specified individuals, fulfilling right-to-erasure requests.

> **Requires:** Paid subscription and `metadata_change` permission.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token obtained from the Protecto Portal (https://portal.protecto.ai/). Include as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN`.

StartDate.name: start_date
StartDate.description: Start of the reporting period. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

EndDate.name: end_date
EndDate.description: End of the reporting period. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

NextPageToken.name: next_page_token
NextPageToken.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the value from the previous response to retrieve the next page.

value.description: The raw sensitive value to mask, or free-form text to auto-detect and mask.

token_name.description: Token type to apply. Required for Mask with Token and Mask with Format modes. Case- and spelling-sensitive.

format.description: Structure-preserving format to apply. Used in Mask with Format mode.

attributes.description: Optional custom metadata key-value pairs associated with this masking operation.

mask.description: List of values to mask. Each item must include at minimum a `value` field.

policy_name.description: Name of a saved policy to apply for detection and tokenization. When provided, all items in `mask` are processed using the policy settings.

value.description: The original sensitive value that was detected.

token_value.description: The token replacing the original value.

prefix.description: Opening entity tag wrapping the token.

suffix.description: Closing entity tag wrapping the token.

ToxicityAnalysis.description: Toxicity scores for the input text on a 0.0–1.0 scale. Scores near 0 indicate low likelihood; scores near 1 indicate high likelihood.

token_value.description: The masked/tokenized output. For auto-detect mode, this is the full text with all entities replaced and wrapped in entity tags.

individual_tokens.description: Array of each individual entity detected and masked. Present in auto-detect mode only.

success.description: `true` when the request was processed without errors.

token_value.description: Tokenized text containing one or more embedded entity tokens (e.g., `<PERSON>VJYe 03W</PERSON>`). All tokens are resolved automatically.

unmask.description: List of tokenized values to unmask.

policy_name.description: Optional named policy to apply during unmasking.

value.description: The fully unmasked original text with all tokens resolved.
value.example: John Doe, can be reached at johndoe@example.com

token_value.description: The original tokenized input, echoed back.

tracking_id.description: Unique identifier for the async job. Use with `/api/vault/async-status` to poll for results.

status.description: List of tracking IDs to check.

tracking_id.description: The tracking ID returned by the async submit endpoint.

status.description: Current state of the async job.

input_payload.description: The original request payload submitted for processing.

result.description: The masking or unmasking output. Only present when `status` is `SUCCESS`. `"None"` when still processing.

error_msg.description: Error description. Present only when `status` is `FAILED`.

submitted_time.description: Timestamp when the job was submitted. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

completed_time.description: Timestamp when the job finished. `"None"` if still in progress.

column_name.description: Name of the column being scanned.

samples.description: Sample values from the column for PII detection.

data_source_name.description: Identifier for the data source being scanned (e.g., `salesforce`, `snowflake`).

object_name.description: Hierarchical path to the object: `[DatabaseName, SchemaName, TableName]`.

tag_type.description: Unique name for the custom PII entity type (uppercase recommended).

identification_endpoint_details.description: Configuration for the external endpoint used to detect this entity type.

method.description: HTTP method to use when calling the identification endpoint.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to include in identification endpoint requests.

description.description: Human-readable description of the policy purpose.
description.example: Policy for masking PII in customer support tickets

namespace_name.description: Target namespace name. Created automatically if it does not exist.

_id.description: User ID or email address to associate with the token.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted to this token.

auth_key.description: The generated authentication token for the namespace user.

namespace_creation.description: Present only when the namespace was newly created as part of this request.

data.description: Response payload. Structure varies by endpoint.

success.description: `true` when the request was processed without errors.

GenericRequestBody.description: Request body. Structure varies by endpoint — refer to individual endpoint descriptions.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request — Invalid or incomplete payload. Fix the request body and retry.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — Missing, invalid, or expired auth token. Refresh or replace the token.

NotFound.description: Not Found — The requested resource does not exist. Verify the endpoint URL and parameters.

RateLimitExceeded.description: Too Many Requests — Rate limit exceeded. Retry using exponential backoff.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Please retry after a few seconds.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error — A processing failure occurred. Safe to retry once. Contact support if the issue persists.
